subject: Cloud Marketplace questionnaire: technical, security, billing sections
messages:
From: Alicia Gomez <procurement+aws@acme-enterprises.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: marketplaceops@cloudpartner.com
Date: 2027-05-08T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: marketplace questionnaire (technical / security / billing)

Hi Neha,

Thanks for taking our call earlier. As discussed, Acme is collecting detailed answers from vendors for our AWS/Azure/GCP marketplace listing evaluation. We need the following sections filled out:
- Technical eligibility (integration, deployment model, supported regions)
- Security/compliance evidence (SOC 2, encryption, data residency)
- Billing and metering (metered billing vs. SaaS subscription; consolidated billing; reseller flows)

Can you send your responses and any supporting artifacts by end of day Friday 5/14? Please include:
- A short table of supported market regions and any limitations
- Which SKU types are available for marketplace metering (tokens, VM hours, seats)
- Sample pricing sheet or an explanation of how usage is reported to marketplace billing systems

I've attached the Acme marketplace questionnaire and a sample contract redline template for reference.

Attachments: Acme_Marketplace_Questionnaire_2027.pdf (attachment stub)

Best,
Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Sr. Procurement Manager, Acme Enterprises

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <procurement+aws@acme-enterprises.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-08T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: marketplace questionnaire (technical / security / billing)

Hi Alicia —

Appreciate the clear list. I've attached our draft answers to the three sections you highlighted and a short SOC 2 summary. High-level notes up front:
- Deployment model: Redwood supports Hosted (Redwood API), Dedicated (reserved GPU pools), and Private (VPC/on-prem) marketplace listings. Marketplace listing will be for our Hosted API offering; Dedicated/Private requires a separate partner onboarding flow.
- Regions: We support us-east-1, us-west-2, eu-west-1, eu-central-1, and ap-southeast-1 for hosted deployments. Dedicated can be provisioned in additional regions by request (lead time applies).
- Billing/metering: Primary marketplace SKU is "inference-unit" (metered by normalized token units). We also support subscription SKUs for committed capacity (monthly reserved units). For AWS Marketplace AMI/Container flows we provide metering hooks; consolidated billing is supported via the standard marketplace reporting payloads.

Attachments included: redwood_marketplace_qs_v1.pdf, soc2-summary.pdf, redwood-pricing-clarity.xlsx

Quick ask: can we get a single point of contact at Acme for legal/procurement so we can align on the redlines and a target go-live window? Proposed next steps in the doc: a 15–30 minute technical clarification call, then submission of any contract redlines.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
O: (415) 555-0162

From: Marketplace Ops <marketplaceops@cloudpartner.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>, Alicia Gomez <procurement+aws@acme-enterprises.com>
Date: 2027-05-08T13:26:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: marketplace questionnaire (technical / security / billing)

Thanks Neha — quick clarifications from the marketplace side:
1) SOC 2: we need a short report with scope and date (you can redact sensitive items). A summary PDF is fine for initial review; full report may be requested later.
2) Metering integration: for AWS we expect a CloudWatch metric or usage API that maps to product codes. Does Redwood publish a marketplace-compatible usage API or will you integrate via AWS metering API?
3) Pricing visibility: we require a mapping of SKU -> marketplace listing price -> effective customer invoice example. If you have an example payload those are useful for our billing team.

Please copy in your billing/product ops. If you can confirm the metering mechanism and provide a short sample payload, we can move the listing validation to the next stage.

- Marketplace Ops

From: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Gomez <procurement+aws@acme-enterprises.com>, Marketplace Ops <marketplaceops@cloudpartner.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-05-08T16:48:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: marketplace questionnaire (technical / security / billing)

Hi Alicia / Marketplace Ops —

Following up with more detail and three attachments (see below). Summary of responses and next steps:

1) Metering integration
- Redwood supports marketplace billing via two mechanisms: a) usage-based metering API that emits normalized "inference-unit" usage events to the marketplace ingestion endpoint, and b) subscription/reserved SKU reporting for committed capacity.
- Example payload and schema attached in redwood-pricing-clarity.xlsx (tab: AWS-metering-sample). Sample event includes customer_id, product_code, unit_count, timestamp, region. We can share a Postman collection or a brief demo of the reporting flow.

2) Security / compliance
- Attached SOC 2 summary notes the control scope (2026-07 thru 2027-06) and auditor (Redwood Audit Partners). Full bridge letter available upon NDA.
- Data at rest encryption: AES-256. In transit: TLS 1.2+ with forward secrecy. Key management integrates with customer KMS/HSM for Private deployments.

3) Technical eligibility & regions
- Hosted listing will be limited initially to us-east-1 and eu-west-1 for marketplace GA to satisfy regional billing controls; we can enable additional regions (us-west-2, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1) within the first 60 days after listing. Dedicated and Private offerings are supported via partner/enterprise onboarding and are not part of the standard marketplace SKU.

4) Billing and consolidated invoicing
- We support consolidated billing and marketplace invoice reconciliation reports. For reseller flows, Redwood can issue marketplace-compatible invoices; for complex reseller flows we request a short MSA addendum.

Attachments: redwood_marketplace_qs_v1.pdf (detailed answers), soc2-summary.pdf (controls summary), redwood-pricing-clarity.xlsx (sample metering payload + pricing mapping)

Proposed next actions:
- Technical sync (30 min) to walk through metering sample + Postman collection — proposed slots Tue 5/11 10:00 or Wed 5/12 14:00 PT
- Legal: share any redlines by 5/14 so we can route internally
